The Q2 2026 Form 10-Q states that, other than the noted financing-covenant update, risk factors had not materially changed from the FY2025 Form 10-K.

The Q2 2026 Form 10-Q adds/updates the restrictive-covenant risk for the new Senior Unsecured Revolving Credit Facility and Senior Notes. The revolver requires a maximum consolidated net-debt-to-EBITDA ratio of 4.00:1.00, with an optional 4.50:1.00 step-up for four fiscal quarters after a qualifying acquisition involving at least $750 million of cash consideration, subject to conditions.
